title: Antimicrobial peptides as computational candidates for SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease inhibition.
authors: Dos Santos Moreira, Erenilson; Siqueira, Sergio; Barbosa, Fabricio Santos; da Silva Sousa, Jailan; Mercado, Hugo Mauricio Pena; Melo, Tarcisio Silva; Jaiswal, Arun Kumar; Azevedo, Vasco; Goes-Neto, Aristoteles; Andrade, Bruno Silva
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白-肽对接、MD模拟和MM/PBSA计算筛选靶向SARS-CoV-2 PLpro的抗菌肽抑制剂，属于蛋白质-配体相互作用的结构计算研究，但对象为肽而非蛋白质结构本身，方法偏工程化应用，缺乏方法创新。
abstract: SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease (PLpro) remains an attractive antiviral target because of its dual role in viral polyprotein processing and host immune modulation. In this study, we employed an exploratory structure-based computational workflow to identify antimicrobial peptide scaffolds with predicted PLpro-binding potential. A total of 6,615 peptides compiled from public databases were screened using protein-peptide docking, followed by molecular dynamics simulations and end-state binding energy analysis for selected complexes. Among the prioritized candidates, peptides 33,035 and 17,047 showed favorable predicted occupation of the catalytic region and persistent interactions with residues in the active-site environment. Molecular dynamics analyses suggested sustained peptide engagement within the PLpro binding region, although distinct degrees of conformational adaptation were observed across systems. MM/PBSA calculations provided additional energetic support for peptide-PLpro association in the selected complexes. In silico toxicity prediction further indicated that peptide 33,035 may require sequence optimization before translational consideration. Overall, our results identify peptide scaffolds worthy of future biochemical and antiviral validation, while reinforcing the need for experimental confirmation and further optimization before any therapeutic inference can be made.
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2 木瓜蛋白酶样蛋白酶 (papain-like protease, PLpro) 因其在病毒多聚蛋白加工和宿主免疫调节中的双重作用，仍是一个有吸引力的抗病毒靶点。在本研究中，我们采用了一种基于结构的探索性计算工作流程，以识别具有预测PLpro结合潜力的抗菌肽支架。利用蛋白质-肽段对接 (protein-peptide docking) 对从公共数据库汇编的共计6,615个肽段进行了筛选，随后对选定的复合物进行了分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和终态结合能分析。在优先候选物中，肽段33,035和17,047显示出对催化区域的有利预测占据，以及与活性位点环境中残基的持续相互作用。分子动力学分析表明，肽段在PLpro结合区域内持续结合，尽管在不同系统中观察到了不同程度的构象适应。MM/PBSA计算为选定复合物中的肽段-PLpro结合提供了额外的能量支持。计算机毒性预测进一步表明，肽段33,035在转化应用前可能需要序列优化。总体而言，我们的结果识别出值得未来生化和抗病毒验证的肽段支架，同时强调在得出任何治疗性推论之前，需要实验确认和进一步优化。
